title: Gatefold repeated-cell report
description: Machine-readable repeated-cell report emitted by gatefold report-cells --format json. Version 10 describes a bounded set of comparable yuurei cells: every supplied run's trace/manifest/export/audit lanes under a runN subject, plus a set lane stating which configuration records each run observed, which differed, and which could not be checked — counts over eligible (bound-export) observations only. This is a descriptive evidence report: no stability verdict, no causal attribution, no ranking, and no generalization beyond the supplied runs.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this result schema. Additive changes keep the version; structural changes bump it.

inputs.description: Descriptors of the supplied runs, labelled run1..runN in argument order.

entries.description: Every statement of the report in contract order: by subject (run1..runN, then subject-less set entries), then lane (association, configuration, execution, audit, set), then each lane's stable ordering.

cellsInput.description: Descriptor of one supplied run: the run directory plus the identities needed to reconcile the report.

name.description: The run's label in this report — run1..runN in --run argument order.

label.description: The run directory argument as supplied.

cellId.description: trace.cell_id — the prepared cell instance id, or null when the trace does not record one. Not the same as run_id, requested_cell.digest, or the pfl snapshot ids.

requestedCellDigest.description: trace.requested_cell.digest — the requested input set, or null when the trace does not record it.

observationStatus.description: The trace's observation.status, or null when no observation record exists.

observationReason.description: The trace's observation.reason (yuurei ADR-0022), echoed verbatim, or null when the record carries none or no observation record exists. Optional so results emitted before the field existed stay valid.

exportObservedSnapshotId.description: data.snapshot.observedSnapshotId of the bound export, or null when none was bound.

exportResolvedSnapshotId.description: data.snapshot.resolvedSnapshotId of the bound export, or null when none was bound.

lane.description: The record family the entry reports: association (trace/export cross-checks), configuration (bound pfl export content), execution (yuurei run records), audit (v0.8 facts), set (repeated-observation statements over the supplied set).

subject.description: The run the entry describes — run1..runN matching inputs.runs[].name; absent on set entries.

id.description: Stable dot-separated entry identifier from docs/v0.10-scope.md (e.g. 'association.export-binding', 'configuration.element.<id>', 'set.element.<id>').

state.description: recorded: a document declares this (content restated, no independent check). verified: the records affirmatively establish the check. inconsistent: two well-formed records contradict each other. unverifiable: a needed record is missing, mismatched, truncated, or uninterpretable. not-recorded: the record the entry reports was never produced — absence reported as absence.

completeness.description: How complete the evidence behind the entry is — separate from state: a bound export declaring completeness 'partial' yields 'partial' entries; an unbound run leaves the set account 'partial'; an unverifiable or absent record is 'unknown'.

statement.description: A descriptive account of what the records declare or what the check established — set statements carry an explicit eligible-observation denominator. Never a causal claim, a stability verdict, or a judgement.

evidence.description: References into the supplied runs' documents that support the entry; every pointer resolves inside its document.

source.description: Which supplied run's document the reference resolves against: the run label run<N> (matching inputs.runs[N-1]) plus the v9 base document name. 'Export' is the digest-verified pfl export artifact declared by that run's observation record.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the document named by source. For Patch/Result it is the artifact's manifest pointer (/artifacts/<i>) with path/lines/bytes locating inside verified bytes; for Manifest it names the manifest entry. The empty string references the whole document.

digest.description: Verified-byte evidence only: the manifest-recorded digest of the stored bytes the reference locates into — for 'Export' it binds the citation to the retained artifact bytes.

path.description: Patch evidence only: the workspace-relative file path whose block the range locates inside the stored patch bytes.

lines.description: Artifact evidence only: an inclusive 1-based line range inside the verified stored bytes.

bytes.description: Artifact evidence only: an inclusive 0-based byte range inside the verified stored bytes.

elementId.description: Export evidence only: the pfl element id the reference is about.

note.description: A short clarifier, e.g. naming an absent field when the pointer references a document root.

transform.description: The build path that produced the entry, e.g. ['report-cells', 'entry:set.element.<id>'] or ['report-cells', 'audit-run', 'fact:patch.stored'].
